# Yarnell School

> > Yarnell School offers online acrylic painting classes and instructional content for adult artists, founded by internationally-recognized painter Jerry Yarnell.

Yarnell School provides comprehensive online art education featuring acrylic painting instruction, video tutorials, and a community of certified artists. The platform preserves Jerry Yarnell's legacy through his PBS painting programs and continues to serve students worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Jerry Yarnell
- Online acrylic painting classes
- Adult art instruction
- Landscape painting
- Wildlife art

## Core Classes & Programs

- [Online Art Classes for Adults](https://yarnellschool.com/online-art-classes-for-adults): Main product page showcasing online acrylic painting classes for adult beginners and intermediate artists
- [Home](https://yarnellschool.com): Homepage for Yarnell School offering adult art painting classes and online instruction
- [Jerry's Gift](https://yarnellschool.com/jerrys%20gift): Free video content and legacy content from Jerry Yarnell's PBS painting programs

## About & Instruction

- [About The Artist](https://yarnellschool.com/about-the-artist): Biography of Jerry Yarnell, founder and internationally-recognized art teacher
- [Tips Before You Begin](https://yarnellschool.com/tips-before-you-begin): Getting started guide with painting tips and studio setup advice for new students
- [Video Tutorials](https://yarnellschool.com/video-tutorials): Video tutorial library and user guide for navigating Yarnell School Online platform

## Community & Support

- [Graduates Archive](https://yarnellschool.com/graduate): Archive of certified Yarnell artists and instructors with student testimonials
- [Contact Us](https://yarnellschool.com/contact): Contact page for customer support and inquiries about art classes and products
- [Guest Book](https://yarnellschool.com/guest-book): Community guestbook for visitor messages and newsletter signup
